About the Scholarship

Theatre SPACEs is an Erasmus Mundus master in theatre for social, participatory, community and educational contexts, and its admission round closes on 1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET. It is one of the few funded European master programmes dedicated entirely to applied and community theatre practice.

OpportunityTheatre SPACEs – Erasmus Mundus Master in Applied and Community Theatre
HostTheatre SPACEs Consortium
LocationParis (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month for 24 months (EMJM scholarship)
Application Deadline1 December 2026 (23:59 CET)
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Theatre SPACEs is an Erasmus Mundus master in theatre for social, participatory, community and educational contexts, and its admission round closes on 1 December 2026 at 23:59 CET. It is one of the few funded European master programmes dedicated entirely to applied and community theatre practice.

Programme Highlights

  • Applied theatre specialisation spanning social, community and educational settings
  • Early deadline of 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET) for the next intake
  • Multi-country mobility with practice-based workshops and field placements
  • Graduates work in community arts, education, cultural policy and social projects

Who Should Apply

Applicants typically come from theatre, performing arts, education, social work and community development backgrounds; practical experience in facilitation or performance strengthens the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance and travel support.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the Theatre SPACEs admission page before the end of November and prepare audition/portfolio materials as specified in the call. Key deadline information: 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Theatre SPACEs Consortium

The Theatre SPACEs consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Theatre for Social, Participatory, Community and Educational contexts, with European partner universities and applied-theatre organisations.

Official website: https://www.theatre-spaces.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
